configuration: No actual .env, production credentials, private key files, Git credentials or database dumps. Environment references and explicit placeholder/test fixtures remain verbatim as part of complete source. Seed/demo passwords are synthetic fixtures, not deployment credentials.
other_pattern_dispositions: Numeric runs in SHA-256 digests are not phone numbers.
Reference paper 2 phone-like numbers are patient test-code fixtures, not evidence of real patient records.
Bibliographic publisher/author contact information and font license attribution are published source/license metadata.
Reference task/opening/midterm examples have blank student identity fields; faculty attribution remains as part of original materials.
limitations: Heuristic scanning and English screenshot OCR are not a proof that every possible personal detail is absent.
academic_identity_choice: User replied 继续 after the explicit identity-field question; interpreted and stated in conversation as permission to retain academic identity fields in unchanged originals. Personal contact records remain excluded.
